verdict: finalist (conditional; validate only, G7 WARN) - employer-paid desk is outside the IL Private Employment Agency Act per statute text (225 ILCS 515/1.1, no candidate fee of any kind) [A]; base y3 op $170,012 / y5 $259,002 on peak funding $12,836, but it is the founder's own labour (base hires only one recruiter in 5 years), perm placement is the most cyclical staffing line (RH perm -57% 2009, -21.7% 2023) [A], and large employers gate agencies; a fast low-capital cash engine, not the durable holding-company core.
